text:
emily_cs: Quick kickoff for MeridianBi dedicated bring-up. They've got sensitive data and asked for conservative autoscale + a dry-run load test. Need quota proposal, canary rules, and a short regression prompt set for soak. Renewal review in 5 weeks. Who picks quota?
jordan_ops: I can draft quota. what's their traffic shape?
emily_cs: Mostly gen for chat (60%) and nightly batch embeddings (40%). Baseline ~45 qps, short bursts to 280 qps for 36m, nightly batch: 3k embed rps for 8min. Avg gen length ~500 tokens, but some sessions up to 2k.
nina_eng: Suggest split pools: gen pool (4 GPUs base) + embed workers (2 smaller instances). Autoscale triggers: gen scale +2 GPUs when 95p latency > 350ms for 45s, scale-down cooldown 6m. For embeddings, spike buffer +2 workers triggered at embed qps > 2000 sustained 30s.
peter_sre: We'll need a KV cache seed. Recommend 18h shadow replay to warm caches. Load test plan: (1) 18h shadow seed; (2) embedding blast 10m@3k rps; (3) gen stepped soak 5m rungs at 50/250/400 concurrent. Monitor 99/95/50p, GPU util, queue length, error-rate.
emily_cs: Can we do the shadow on the dedicated pool without touching prod?
opsbot: shadow-run created: job/meridian-shadow-1854 (ETA 2h).
jordan_ops: Shadow only on dedicated pool, yes. We'll tag traffic and rate-limit origins. Need client samples for 48h or synthetic traffic pattern if they can't share.
nina_eng: Canary flow: start with 2 GPUs receiving 10% traffic for 20m. If errors > 0.15% or 99p latency regresses > 25% vs baseline, rollback to quantized fallback variant. Also include an automatic fallback to hosted regional model if pool health drops.
haley_fin: Finance asked for cost-per-100M tokens under three configs: with KV caching, without caching, and with reserved capacity amortized. I'll prepare a small appendix after quota draft. Also note they want 45d audit log retention.
emily_cs: timeline: quota draft by Wed 11AM PT, shadow Thu morning, soak Thu afternoon, tentative go-live Mon. OK?
jordan_ops: I'll post quota numbers by Tue EOD so you can review Wed morning.
peter_sre: Need oncall for Thu 13:00-17:00. Assigning @infra-oncall. Also we'll monitor metric-aggregator-lag during shadow; if lag > 3s abort.
nina_eng: For stress tool use this wrk example to hit token tails:
```
wrk -t10 -c350 -d5m --latency http://dedicated/meridian/v1/gen
```
Adjust concurrency to simulate burst concurrency.
emily_cs: small regression ask: include 6 prompts that historically show hallucination or truncation. Keep them in the PR.
jordan_ops: posting quota spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/drive/meridian-quota-v1 (comments welcome). For now I propose reserve 6 GPUs base, burst buffer +3, and 2 dedicated embed workers.
haley_fin: I'll produce cost appendix after quota sign-off and include a renewal risk note.
opsbot: deploy/bastion check: no infra maintenance scheduled during Thu 13:00-17:00 window.
emily_cs: great. Action items summarized: @jordan_ops quota draft, @nina_eng canary + fallback PR, @peter_sre schedule oncall & run shadow, @haley_fin cost appendix. I'll send timeline to MeridianBi after quota sign-off. Thanks all :sparkles:
